After years of delays, the Mobile River Bridge and Bayway project is finally moving toward construction. This is a major win for Mobile, Baldwin County, the Gulf Coast, and the entire Southeast.

Thanks to President Trump’s leadership, Alabama is one step closer to delivering this transformational infrastructure project.
